facts.fact: The Minister of Land Reform's written reply of 22 May 2026 says the department is implementing the Electronic Deeds Registration System (eDRS) under the 2019 Act, expected fully functional by 31 March 2029, while SITA, its implementing agent, is causing challenges.

systems.owner: Deeds Registration Trading Entity (implementing agent SITA)

ZAF.note: Only an interface from eDRS to Home Affairs is mentioned; no population register is described.
The reply concerns deeds registration and land restitution; nothing on local government offices.
